basics.name: Jing Ting Zheng
basics.label: Student
basics.summary: I graduated from the University of California, Berkeley with a Master's of Engineering in Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences in May 2026.

highlights: Create a full-stack web application using Flask, Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, Amazon Web Services to gather structured and unstructured research data for affective computing studies.

Running a mixed-methods human-computer interaction (HCI) study to evaluate the usability of the system and the system's capacity to gather useful data and labels for training affective computing AI models.
Developed a robust web application with React, Node.js, Express.js to optimize naval asset routing planning for enhanced and rapid decision making capabilities
Improved asset readiness and support for mission-critical operations through interactive map visualizations with Leaflet and seamless integration with military systems
Built comprehensive documentation to define downstream and upstream data workflow and integration processes by extracting data using SQL, improving data management and governance
Investigated data transformations in accounting data to translate them into efficient data pipelines and data processing workflows, reducing manual work and increasing operational efficiency
Performed data wrangling and statistical analyses like Pearson correlation coefficient using SAS on multiple large datasets involving over 100,000 participant’s data
mplemented data visualization techniques to communicate findings on the topic of comparing dietary indices in children and adults in the Pacific to the general public
Analyzed Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System data using statistical analyses in R and communicated results using data visualizations

volunteer.position: Computer Science Research Mentorship Program Scholar
highlights: Participated in machine learning research discussions and computing pathways exploration while being mentored by a Google researcher working in the applied research area.
Provide insightful mentorship to students regarding college admissions and applications, scholarship essays, interview tips, and prepare materials for college and career workshops
Designed a mobile application prototype in Figma for Kapiolani Medical Center to improve collaboration and consistency in rehabilitative care between patients and healthcare providers
Aligned product development with user needs and business goals by conducting in-depth user research and adhering to strict HIPAA compliance standards
President, Supporting Women in Information Technology & Computing (SWITCH), 2022-2025
Chair, Association for Computing Machinery Women Chapter, 2022-2025
